company_name: CIRCUIT FABOLOGY MICROELECTRONICS EQUIPMENT CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in direct imaging and lithography equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Circuit Fabology Microelectronics Equipment Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and production of advanced direct imaging and direct writing lithography equipment. With a strong emphasis on independent innovation and a robust intellectual property portfolio, the company aims to enhance semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.China: The company is located in the Integrated Circuit Industry Base of Hefei High-tech Zone, Anhui Province.
